name: Bloodglass Visor
flavour: Pay in life, collect in lightning.
note: Blood magic with big added cold, fire and lightning damage to spells, spell damage, strength and all resistances. The 'while no life is reserved' condition is dropped (the added damage always applies) and the variant Mortal Conviction line is dropped.
drop: Cold Damage to Spells while no Life
Fire Damage to Spells while no Life
Lightning Damage to Spells while no Life

name: Emberwrit Circlet
flavour: Sign in ash, and the signatories answer.
note: Energy shield, faster minions and a huge minion damage bonus. The reference line is about burning spirits only; here the damage bonus covers all minions (Call Furies is the spirit analog). The spirit count penalty, the always-ignite and the duration refresh lines are dropped.
drop: Maximum number of Summoned Raging Spirits

name: Assize Crown
flavour: Judgement spreads to whoever stands close.
note: Huge armour and energy shield with all attributes. The reference grants its bonuses to nearby allies; Bob has no allies, so the character gets them: global defences per 100 strength, critical strike multiplier per 100 dexterity and cast speed per 100 intelligence. The reduced reservation line is dropped.

name: Whorl Helm
flavour: Every thought circles back home.
note: Cold and lightning damage with a deep mana pool. Damage taken gained as mana over time is approximated by a small flat mana gain when you are hit. The extra energy shield from maximum mana, the leech restrictions and the enemy leech line are dropped.
drop: Gain (5-10)% of Maximum Mana as Extra
of Damage taken Gained as Mana

name: Featherstorm Hood
flavour: Wings first, weather after.
note: Evasion, life, lightning resistance and movement speed, and it casts the avian boon (Feathered Boon) when you hit an enemy, every 12 seconds. The tornado trigger on gaining the boon is dropped.

name: Orator's Garland
flavour: The hounds follow the voice.
note: Dexterity and skill effect duration, with minion attack and movement speed that grows with dexterity (2% per 50). The ignited-only minion kill rule is dropped.

name: Sinewlord Helm
flavour: Muscle is a kind of command.
note: Plus two to socketed minion gems, strength and minion life. Half of your strength going to minions is approximated as 1% increased minion damage per 10 strength; one more minion per 300 strength (it applies to all minions, not only zombies). The leech at 1000 strength is dropped.
drop: Half of your Strength is added to your Minions
to maximum number of Zombies per 300 Strength

name: Smoulderplate Helm
flavour: Heat that learned to stand upright.
note: Armour and life with less fire damage taken from hits. Armour scaling with fire resistance is approximated by a flat 75% increased armour (the usual capped fire resistance); the fire reduction applies to attack hits.
drop: Armour is increased by Uncapped Fire Resistance

name: Pyreplate Helm
flavour: It wears the blaze and calls it armour.
note: Big armour, some physical damage taken as fire and a fire resistance penalty. Armour scaling with uncapped fire resistance is approximated by a flat 45% increased armour (a capped resistance minus the penalty).
drop: Armour is increased by Uncapped Fire Resistance

name: Gravecall Circlet
flavour: Names the dead, and they come.
note: Plus two to socketed minion gems with a lot of energy shield. Minion life regeneration and spectre life are dropped (minions cannot be hurt, no spectres).

name: Twinflame Hatchet
flavour: One edge burns, and the burn does not forget the chill.
note: Written as the main-hand half: big added fire damage, ignite chance, attack speed and more ignite damage against chilled enemies. The off-hand cold damage and chill on hit lines are dropped (hand-specific).
drop: Damage with Ignites inflicted on Chilled Enemies
25% Chance to Ignite when in Main Hand
Chill Enemies for 1 second on Hit

name: Potter's Maul
flavour: Shapes what will soon shape others.
note: Grants the stone golem skill (Stone Colossus) with one more minion, minion life, attack speed, added physical damage and a lower enemy stun threshold. The minion added-physical line is dropped (folded into the weapon's own damage).
drop: Can Summon up to 1 additional Golem

name: Fleetsong Blade
flavour: Run first, strike with the wind.
note: Huge physical damage and attack speed with evasion while moving and two additional projectiles. The 'used a movement skill recently' condition is dropped (the projectiles always apply). Far Shot is dropped.
drop: 2 additional Projectiles if you've used a Movement Skill Recently

name: Dicebrand
flavour: Roll again: the fire, the frost, the spark.
note: Physical damage is converted to elements (a random element in the reference, here an even three-way split of 99%), every hit can inflict elemental ailments, and more damage against ignited, frozen and shocked enemies.

name: Slumber Cutlass
flavour: Its dreamers do not wake gently.
note: Minion damage with all attributes and accuracy. The minion poison chance and the life recovery on killing a poisoned enemy are dropped.
drop: Minions have 60% chance to Poison Enemies on Hit

name: Wager Blade
flavour: Half its edge is a gamble.
note: Half the physical damage is converted to elements (a random element in the reference, here split evenly) and every hit can inflict elemental ailments, with life on kill.
drop: 50% of Physical Damage from Hits with this Weapon is Converted

name: Winterbride Sabre
flavour: She is cold, and she is quick.
note: Physical damage, attack speed and a quarter of physical damage as extra cold. The increased damage taken from skeletons and ghosts is dropped.

name: Forkfeather Quiver
flavour: Each shaft finds a second throat.
note: Projectile damage, accuracy and life on hit at a projectile speed cost. Projectiles fork in the reference; here they chain once (an extra target per projectile).

name: Standmaker Quiver
flavour: Where it hangs, a post goes up.
note: Mana, mana regeneration, accuracy and mana leech with one additional totem at a time (applies to every totem skill, not only attack ones).
drop: Attack skills can have 1 additional Totem

name: Saltmire Band
flavour: Cursed with stone and with storm.
note: Plus three to socketed minion (golem) gems with spell damage, energy shield and lightning resistance. The golem buff effect and golem energy shield lines are dropped.
drop: Effect of Buffs granted by Socketed Golem Skills
Socketed Golem Skills gain 20% of Maximum Life

name: Lifeline Loop
flavour: Hearts kept in step.
note: Life and mana regeneration with more minion life. The minion area of effect and the physical damage taken on minion death are dropped.
drop: Minions have 10% increased Area of Effect
350 Physical Damage taken on Minion Death

name: Yokemark Ring
flavour: Look at it, and you kneel.
note: Enemies you hit are cursed. The reference uses a socketed curse gem; here the curse is fixed to the elemental weakness hex at level 10.
drop: Curse Enemies with Socketed Curse Gem on Hit

name: Hushgale Seal
flavour: The storm holds its tongue.
note: Plus three to socketed minion (golem) gems, added physical damage to attacks, attack speed and dodge. The golem cast speed and onslaught lines are dropped.
drop: Socketed Golem Skills have 20% increased Attack and Cast Speed

name: Rustforge Band
flavour: Strength first, fire after.
note: Plus three to socketed minion (golem) gems with strength, life and fire damage. The golem taunt and life regeneration lines are dropped.
drop: Socketed Golem Skills have 25% chance to Taunt
Socketed Golem Skills have 5% Life Regenerated

name: Reefflare Ring
flavour: Bright, shallow and expensive.
note: Added fire damage to attacks and elemental attack damage at a rarity cost. The ring-slot reflect reduction lines are dropped (no reflected damage taken).

name: Coilwind Ring
flavour: Cold shot twice, or round the corner.
note: Cold damage and cast speed with spell projectiles that chain once more (the right-ring-slot half applied wherever it is worn). The fork, no-pierce and left-slot lines are dropped.

name: Anchorfall Blade
flavour: Fits any hand that grips it.
note: Accuracy, physical damage and added physical damage with mana gained on hit. The 'counts as all one handed melee weapon types' line is dropped.
drop: Counts as all One Handed Melee Weapon Types
